prompt:
Edit IMAGE ONE, the existing six-chest atlas, into the final readable BLUE / PURPLE / GOLD tier family. IMAGE TWO is only an actual game-world style reference; do not include its player, HUD, terrain, targets or background. Output exactly one 1536x1024 transparent PNG atlas, with the SAME three columns and two rows, top CLOSED and bottom OPEN.

The user rejected image one because all three tiers looked too similar in color. Make tier colors strongly visible over the LARGE BODY AND LID PANELS, not just tiny jewels. Keep the existing distinct flat / arched / clock-crown construction, viewing angle, support feet, physical width, and paired open/closed lower bodies. Keep every lid attached to the same physical chest.

LEFT COLUMN, MEDIUM: clear weathered STEEL BLUE / DUSTY COBALT painted wood or enamel panels over most of the front, sides and lid. Blue must occupy at least two-thirds of the visible broad panels, with narrow aged-brass bands and old gold latch as accents. Cool blue highlights, deep navy shadows, small brown chips where the worn paint exposes old wood. Read as a BLUE CHEST instantly at small game scale.

MIDDLE COLUMN, HIGH: clear worn AMETHYST PURPLE / ROYAL VIOLET enamel or lacquer panels over most of the front, sides and arched lid. Purple must occupy at least two-thirds of broad panels, with narrow aged-brass reinforcement and split-gear lock. Violet highlights and dark indigo shadows, keep old crafted metal character. Read as a PURPLE CHEST instantly, distinct from blue.

RIGHT COLUMN, REGION TOP: rich OLD GOLD / AMBER BRASS as the dominant broad surfaces and clock-crown frame, with dark auburn recesses and a radial clock seal. Gold remains clearly different from blue and purple. Top-left light, stepped corner feet, restrained teal inlays. Valuable crafted metal, not a glowing light source.

Both states in each column use the same tier color and same material wear. Open interiors are EMPTY and dark charcoal; show enough tier-colored body and underside-lid framing to identify the tier even when opened. Do not enlarge or rescale the lower boxes between their closed/open pair. Preserve common support-foot baseline and original positioning within each cell.

Match the established game style: crisp fine-pixel clusters, readable stepped contours, dark cool outlines, limited value groups, restrained warm highlights from upper left. Keep the old-brass material language, but DO NOT let gold bands overwhelm the new BLUE/PURPLE panels. No neon, vector art, photorealism, glossy toy plastic, smooth painterly shading, text, numbers, coins, loot or particles.

CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY CORRECTION: REMOVE EVERY brown ambient halo, black background wash, floor shadow, glow and vignette from image one. Outside the six chest silhouettes must be TRUE ZERO-ALPHA transparency, including all canvas corners and continuous empty gutters. The chest bodies themselves should be opaque. No shadow ellipses, ground, scenery, frames or matte background. Each complete sprite stays inside its own 512-square cell with at least32 source pixels clear margin; preserve feet and raised lid tips completely. Keep six separate STATIC poses only; not animation frames.
